occurrences.text: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.
occurrences.reasonJa: 24:21はイシヤ（Isshiah）と記す。別候補のイザヤへ混同しない。

occurrences.text: His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.
occurrences.reasonJa: 26:25にレハブヤの子イザヤとして明記。24:21のIsshiahとは別の綴り・文脈。
